name: Pembrolizumab + CARBOplatin + PACLitaxel then Pembrolizumab Maintenance (KEYNOTE-407, NSCLC squamous)
cyclesNote: Induction: 4 cycles every 21 days of pembrolizumab 200 mg + carboplatin AUC 6 + paclitaxel 200 mg/m2 Day 1. Maintenance: pembrolizumab 200 mg every 21 days (up to 2 years / 35 cycles per pembrolizumab schedule, DeVita line 233347 to 233348). Alternative pembrolizumab schedule: 400 mg every 6 weeks. Alternative taxane: nab-paclitaxel (dose not established in cited sources).

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.PD_L1: any (benefit shown in both PD-L1 < 1% and PD-L1 >= 1%)
biomarkers.note: Chemoimmunotherapy for metastatic SQUAMOUS NSCLC regardless of PD-L1 expression. Pembrolizumab plus carboplatin plus a taxane (paclitaxel or nab-paclitaxel). The panel does NOT recommend pembrolizumab plus cisplatin with a taxane (fewer data). Trial excluded sensitizing EGFR/ALK alterations; oncogene-driven NSCLC is directed to targeted therapy first-line (drivers are uncommon in squamous). PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitor contraindications must be excluded. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer, Systemic Therapy for Metastatic Disease (KEYNOTE-407); DeVita 12th ed.

premedications.name: PACLitaxel premedication
premedications.notes: corticosteroid, H1 and H2 antihistamine premedication per paclitaxel labeling to prevent hypersensitivity.

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: carboplatin/paclitaxel is moderate emetic risk; give prophylaxis.

supportiveCare: immune-related adverse event monitoring for pembrolizumab (thyroid, hepatic, pulmonary/pneumonitis, colitis, endocrinopathies, myocarditis)
carboplatin dosed to target AUC (Calvert formula); moderate emetic-risk antiemetic prophylaxis
monitoring: immune-related toxicity screen (TSH/free T4, LFTs, glucose, cortisol as indicated) during pembrolizumab

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 2 or higher immune-related adverse event
doseModificationRules.text: Hold pembrolizumab and manage with corticosteroids per immune-related adverse event guidance; obtain clinical review before rechallenge.
Reduce or hold paclitaxel per neuropathy grade; clinical review.

drugs.name: Pembrolizumab
drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed. line 70724 (pembrolizumab 200 mg every 3 weeks) and line 233347 (flat 200 mg every 3 weeks or 400 mg every 6 weeks, up to 2 years). Given Day 1 with carboplatin/taxane induction (4 cycles) and continued as maintenance monotherapy. Alternative schedule: 400 mg IV every 6 weeks.

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: Chapter 30: pembrolizumab 200 mg every 3 weeks (line 70724); flat dose 200 mg every 3 weeks or 400 mg every 6 weeks, for up to 2 years (line 233347)

drugs.name: CARBOplatin
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v7.2026, NSCL-F footnote g line 4838 (carboplatin AUC 6 as the carboplatin/paclitaxel doublet dose). Platinum backbone of the induction (cycles 1 to 4). Target AUC via Calvert formula (basis auc, unit AUC). ISMP tall-man (CARBOplatin).

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
provenance.locator: NSCL-F 1 of 2, footnote g: paclitaxel 200 mg/m2 and carboplatin AUC 6 every 21 days (line 4838)

drugs.name: PACLitaxel
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v7.2026, NSCL-F footnote g line 4838 (paclitaxel 200 mg/m2 every 21 days). Induction only (cycles 1 to 4). Requires corticosteroid + H1/H2 antihistamine premedication per paclitaxel labeling. ISMP tall-man (PACLitaxel). Source-recognized alternative taxane: albumin-bound (nab-)paclitaxel (named as the taxane option in KEYNOTE-407, DeVita lines 70920 to 70926); its per-cycle dose and schedule are NOT stated in the cited sources and are left to clinical review rather than encoded here.
